scenes.title: ONE PLAYER. ONE SCREEN.
scenes.label: THE ACTUAL HOST GRID / A REAL 64-CAR RACE
scenes.text: One player. One screen. Pretty normal so far.

scenes.title: FOUR MATES.
scenes.label: EVERY PLAYER GETS THEIR OWN CHASE CAMERA
scenes.text: Four mates? Split it four ways.

scenes.title: SIXTY-FOUR. NO PLAYER CAP.
scenes.label: 64 IS A SAMPLE, NEVER A LIMIT
scenes.text: Sixty-four drivers. One shared screen. And there's no player cap.

scenes.title: BRING THE WHOLE MOB.
scenes.label: JOYSTICK JAMMERS / 64 CARS / ONE RACE
scenes.text: This is Joystick Jammers. Bring the whole mob.

scenes.title: A FRESH TRACK. EVERY TIME.
scenes.label: GENERATED TRACKS / DIRT / BITUMEN / TOWN / ROCKS
scenes.text: Every track is generated fresh. Dirt, bitumen, town streets, and rocky country.

scenes.title: A COMPLETELY REASONABLE ROAD.
scenes.label: LOOP-THE-LOOPS / GENERATED INTO THE TRACK
scenes.text: And then someone put a loop in the road. Completely reasonable.

scenes.title: PICK YOUR PRIDE AND JOY.
scenes.label: CRUZ MISSILE / AU HAWK / TRADIE UTE / LION PRESIDENT
scenes.text: Take the Cruz Missile, the A U Hawk, the Tradie Ute, or the Lion President.

scenes.title: YOU LITTLE BEAUTIES.
scenes.label: PIG CATCHER / POSTIE BIKE / HAWK DASH
scenes.text: Or stir things up with the Pig Catcher, the Postie Bike, and the Hawk Dash.

scenes.title: BRING WHATEVER YOU'VE GOT.
scenes.label: PHONES / KEYBOARDS / GAMEPADS / ONE SHARED GAME
scenes.text: Your phone is the controller. Or bring a keyboard or a gamepad. Get everyone in.

scenes.title: JOYSTICK JAMMERS
scenes.label: JAMMERS.DILGER.DEV
scenes.text: Joystick Jammers. Bring everyone. Play in your browser.
